title: doctor fails hooks-user when the registered command cannot start
source: intended: plan 2.4 doctor half (owner question 8): doctor reports the user-scope guard
intent: INTENDED behavior (plan 2.4). After `setup hook --scope user --yes` the command is the bare word `jitso`; with no `jitso` on the sandbox PATH the line is `fail hooks-user: jitso is not on PATH` and doctor exits 3, the same rule as the project line.

stdout.regex: (?m)^fail hooks-user: jitso is not on PATH$
